tracked_chunks.rationale: Startup shell should stay route-driven and avoid regressing into a monolithic entry bundle.
Core React and router runtime is the largest shared chunk and should not drift upward without intent.
Charting stays off the startup path and should remain bounded as the heavy data-viz vendor island.
Pipeline-specific graph UI should remain isolated to its lazy route family. Budget raised from 135 to 145 to accommodate governance kernel (getter-based feature flags replacing static booleans).
Opportunity chart surface code is shared across analysis routes and should stay compact.
Workerized dagre layout is intentionally separate; keep its payload bounded.
Icon payload should remain a small shared helper, not a hidden growth bucket.
Common formatting utilities are shared across many routes and should stay modest.
Shared UI primitives should remain lightweight.
